title: Bio-Pore Terminology Reference
source_framework: Reasoning on Pore Terminology in 3D Bioprinting (Trifonov et al., 2024)

lexicon.definition: Interconnected pore structure within a 3D-printed scaffold or hydrogel matrix having a diameter less than 25 micrometers.
Interconnected pore structure within a 3D-printed scaffold or hydrogel matrix having a diameter between 25 and 100 micrometers.
Interconnected pore structure within a 3D-printed scaffold or hydrogel matrix having a diameter greater than 100 micrometers.
